data.name: Just One More Spell
data.detailed_description:
Just One More Card is a spell crafting rouge-lite inspired by the great deck-builders. test

Desperation has forced you to start gathering elements for spells from scratch lotto cards. Buy cards from a magical bodega and defend yourself from waves of monsters by combining elements to creating RIDICULOUS spells. Find magical treasures in the depths of this dungeon that you can sell (or use) to get yourself out of this hole. 

Big Magic Corps have monetized every form of magic. A once stable wizard has become destitute taking on riskier and riskier bets for a dangerous reward in this endless dungeon.

Combine a planned 60 elements and their respective debuffs to make unique spells. FInd secret recipes for elements that create legendary spells that have the potential to apply the most powerful debuffs that weaken enemies or exponentially increase damage. Spell recipes are saved between runs giving rise to knowledge-based meta-progression.

Is this meant to be gambling? NO, upgrade your cards in hundreds of ways to control the odds of elements and alter the debuffs they apply. You are meant to break the game and flip the odds on the house.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or more
  • Processor: Intel i3 4th generation or equivalent
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Most dedicated GPUs should work.

content_descriptors.notes: Themes of gambling, but no actual gambling in this game. Odds are controlled by the player and meant to be beaten. No real money will ever be asked from the player.
